servinfo.title: Accessory Drive Belt Removal and Installation

attention2.ptxt: When removing and installing accessory drive belt, repulsive force of belt tensioner may cause a finger injury.
Handle belt tensioner carefully during service for accessory drive belt.

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when compressing the accessory drive belt tensioner can cause damage to the tensioner.

item.ptxt: Do not apply a force of more than 130 N·m (13.3 kgf-m, 96.0 lbf-ft) when compressing the tensioner.
Do not apply more force when the tensioner stops at full stroke.

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove right side engine under side cover.
Remove right side front fender lining.
Remove accessory drive belt as follows.

s2.ptxt: Fitting wrench to hexagonal section (1) of accessory drive belt lower tensioner, compress the tensioner by turning it clockwise until holes (2) align, and then retain the position inserting a pin.
Fitting wrench to hexagonal section (1) of accessory drive belt upper tensioner, compress the tensioner by turning it counterclockwise.

s1.ptxt: Install accessory drive belt as follows.

s2.ptxt: Check that accessory drive belt lower tensioner is kept in the compressed position with a pin inserted.
Fitting wrench to hexagonal section (1) of accessory drive belt upper tensioner, compress the tensioner by turning it counterclockwise.
Turn accessory drive belt lower tensioner clockwise a little with wrench and remove retaining pin and then release torque slowly to give tension to the belt.

s1.ptxt: Turn crankshaft clockwise 720° and check that all of belt ribs are fitted into all of pulley grooves.
Run engine for 2 to 3 seconds to stabilize the belt tension.
Stop engine and check the state of the belt.
Install right side front fender lining.
Install right side engine under side cover.
